note: IRS optional standard mileage rate for business driving in 2026. The IRS changed it mid-year: 72.5 cents a mile for driving before July 1, 2026, and 76 cents a mile from July 1, 2026 (Announcement 2026-11, modifying Notice 2026-10). The mileage log app uses the rate for each trip's date and tells the member to check irs.gov before filing. Re-check every December.
